notes.title: ⚔️ New Game Reveal: Perk Up!
notes.content:
👋 Welcome to Perk Up! — your new favorite party game!
We’re thrilled to have you here as we lift the curtain on our next wild ride.

🎉 Perk Up!
— A multiplayer deck-building fighting game where death makes you stronger.

💀 Death fuels strength — fall, rise, dominate.
With over 258,814,098,655,667,781,615,336 build possibilities, every match is a fresh chance to evolve into the ultimate fighter.
Battle it out in fast-paced arenas where every defeat powers your comeback.


➡️ Add Perk Up! to your Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645920/Perk_Up

🟣 Thank you for supporting Sphereka — see you in the arena!
